title: Align depth and blending for ext-only mesh pipeline to avoid seams
purpose: Match additive blending and depth test/write behavior between ext-only and full mesh pipelines to prevent hard split artifacts during transitions.

steps.detail: Ensure ext-only pipeline uses depthTestEnable=VK_TRUE, depthWriteEnable=VK_FALSE, compare=LESS, identical to full mesh pipeline.
Keep additive blend factors identical (SRC_ALPHA, ONE).
At pipeline creation, log key states for both pipelines to confirm parity.

acceptance: No visible plane seam between halves of the cloud
